Remove habitat under barriers

Source: R/terra-connectivity.R
drop_habitat_under_barrier.Rd

Performs a terra::mask() operation, to remove the habitat parts that are under the mask. Habitat is any cell that is neither NA nor 0.

Usage

drop_habitat_under_barrier(habitat, barrier_mask)

Arguments

habitat

Terra SpatRaster. Habitat layer.

barrier_mask

Terra SpatRaster. Barrier mask.

Value

Terra SpatRaster with habitat remaining after barrier removal, coded 1 for habitat and NA everywhere else.

Examples

lizard_habitat <- example_habitat()
lizard_barrier <- example_barrier()
barrier_mask <- create_barrier_mask(lizard_barrier)
remaining_habitat <- drop_habitat_under_barrier(
  habitat = lizard_habitat,
  barrier = lizard_barrier
  )
remaining_habitat
